primary_sources.title: Constance Leidy and Laurentiu Maxim, Higher-order Alexander invariants of plane algebraic curves (2006)
primary_sources.used_statement: Proof of Theorem4.7: epimorphism from the link-at-infinity complement group onto the affine complement group; no general-position-at-infinity assumption on this epimorphism.

primary_sources.title: Peter Scott, The geometries of 3-manifolds, Bull. London Math. Soc.15(1983),401-487
primary_sources.used_statement: Sections2 and3: Seifert and orbifold group presentations, fiber exact sequence, Euler class as a section obstruction; Theorem3.6 covers unbranched Seifert covers. The ordinary-base-branch extension used here is separately proved by section obstruction, not quoted as Theorem3.6.

primary_sources.title: Maciej Borodzik, Morse theory for plane algebraic curves, Journal of Topology (2012), doi:10.1112/jtopol/jts006
primary_sources.used_statement: Proof of Corollary5.19: coprime polynomial parametrization degrees give the torus knot T(p,q) at affine infinity.
